title: Is there a way to disable mouse function on certain maps for different minigames?

posts.author: elang_S
posts.body:
I researched a bit into how rpg maker as an engine could do with point and click mechanics and I found that point and click features can only be done via plugins, even then it isn't 100% pure point and click as it uses the player characters that are present in game as the "cursor"
After experimenting with the native mouse controls in MV, I find it less than ideal for a usual point and click mechanic as it requires each click to be instantaneously while I found after clicking with MV native mouse controls there's an initial lag, I try putting impassable tiles to even adjusting the speed of the character to force a pseudo point and click but found the response not consistent as sometimes the click immediately shows text while sometimes it either doesn't show text or even show the event text even though I'm clicking on other places (I think the character model and the area that's not the event actually share's a trajectory and that's why the other points show text where it shouldn't), it's also frustrating that the mouse clicks at times ignore the impassable objects and moved the character around anyways
I want to use plugins to fix this issue but unfortunately Yanfly's point and click plugin is paid to use while I myself don't have the means to purchase the plugin
There is this Mouse System Ex by Tor Damian Design that seems promising, but I see the documentation site is broken, the one download link contains a setup which I find very suspicious as what I understood javascript files don't require a setup (do correct me if I'm mistaken)
After moments of contemplation, I think I have no choice but to compromise the design as I save money for Yanfly's plugin (to this day I'm sad that my currency is so weak
), I think I'm not going to make a fully point and click game, instead I'm going to make the keyboard the main control while the mouse is only used for certain minigames like puzzles and the like.
(I will be beyond happy if there's an easier and more effective way to implement point and click elements in MV)
But I'm kind of at a loss in how I can disable the mouse controls in only certain points in the game without outright disabling mouse controls fully. How can I readjust mouse controls if I may ask?
